Schedule

The tab with the schedule of classes for the current week opens to the user immediately upon logging into the application. The schedule for today opens automatically. To open a schedule for any day the user should click on the button with the required date. Buttons "Back" and "Forward" with a short press allows the user to skip to the previous or next week, respectively, and with a long press, they allow the user to select and switch to an arbitrary date in the schedule. The button "Update schedule", located at the bottom of the screen, allows you to update the schedule manually if necessary.

The times schedule at the college is available to the user by clicking on the appropriate tab. This tab contains times for Monday and times from Tuesday to Friday.

The following buttons are available in the control panel at the top of the schedule screen, from left to right:

  • Share
  • Download schedule
  • More options

Button "Share"
Depending on the opened tab ("Lessons Schedule" or "Times Schedule"), when the button is clicked, the corresponding happens:

  • A screen opens to share the lessons schedule for the opened days of the week
  • A screen opens to share the times schedule

Button "Download schedule"
Depending on the open tab ("Lessons Schedule" or "Times Schedule"), when the button is clicked, the corresponding happens:

  • The available source files with the lessons schedule are downloaded.
  • The available source files with the times schedule are downloaded.

Notes

The user can make and view his notes for the schedule. To use this function, Click on the badge icon at the bottom of the class schedule for the day. By clicking it, the user gets on the notes.
Screen "Notes"
This screen contains all notes created by the user for previously selected groups and days. By pressing notes, the user can choose them for the following purposes:

  • Edit (if 1 note is selected)
  • Delete
  • Share

Creation of notes
By clicking on the "Create a note" button in the lower right corner of the notes of the notes, the user gets on the screen of creating notes. On this screen, the user may indicate:
  • Date for note
  • Group for note
  • The topic for the note
  • The text of the note. The text of the note can be entered using the keyboard, as well as voice input (works even without connecting to the Internet).

For the mobile version
For a mobile version of the application, you can attach photos taken during the creation of a note, as well as the device selected from the gallery.

For the mobile version
Reminders of notes
For users of the mobile version of the application, if they activated this item in the settings, When creating or editing the notes, it is available to create recall for it. When creating a reminder, The user will be offered the time in which the application will remind him of the note. It will also be proposed The choice of a number of days for which it is worth reminding us of a note. At the appointed time and day, a notification of a note, With the ability to postpone it for an hour or day, it will be delivered to the user.

Search for notes
The user can look for notes on their content. To do this, you need to enter a word to search in a test The field of input at the top of the screen of notes. In the process of input, the user will show notes, containing this word.
Filtering of notes
To the right of the search for notes to the user is available a filter of notes. This filter allows you to find notes for these groups and time period.

Settings

The following items are available in the application settings:

  • Schedule display mode
  • Search by teacher
  • Do not update times
  • Download schedule for
  • Enable caching
  • Theme
  • Language
  • Transliteration for schedule
For the mobile version, the list is expanded by the following items:
Category Notifications
  • Application updates
  • Schedule
  • Notes
In addition to these items, the following functions are available in the settings:
  • Clear data
  • Transfer data
  • Share the application
  • Contact the developer

Schedule display mode
This menu item allows you to choose between the following schedule display modes:

  • In a separate window. This mode displays the schedule for each day in a separate window.
  • Together. This mode displays the schedules for all days together.

Item Search by teacher
This item adds the ability to search for classes by teacher to the main screen.

Item Do not update times
When this item is activated, the times schedule is downloaded only once when installing the application, which will help save the user's Internet traffic.

Item Download schedule for
This menu item allows you to select the college building to download the schedule from the following options:

  • All buildings
  • First building
  • Second building
Specifying the desired option will help save the user's Internet traffic.

Item Enable caching
This menu item allows you to enable caching of network requests, which will help save the user's Internet traffic.

Item Theme
In this item, you can select the application theme from the following options:

  • Light theme
  • Dark theme
The system theme option is also available, which sets the application theme to the user's current theme selected in the system.

Item Language
This item allows you to select the language of the application interface.
This item affects only the interface language, the schedule is still only available in Russian.
The following languages ​​are currently supported:

  • Russian
  • Belarusian
  • Kazakh
  • Ukrainian
  • Azerbaijan
  • Armenian
  • Georgian
  • English
The system language option is also available, which sets the language of the application to the user's system, if it is in the list of supported ones, and Russian otherwise.

Item Transliteration for schedule
This item enables transliteration of the class schedule in Latin letters, which may be convenient for non-Russian-speaking users.

Items for the mobile version:

Item Application updates
By activating this item, the user can receive notifications about updates of the mobile and desktop versions of the application.

Item Schedule
By activating this item, the user can receive notifications about updates of the schedule, the Internet traffic consumption of the application in this case will increase.

Item Notes
By activating this item, the user can add reminders to notes.

Additional functions:

Clear data
Allows you to delete selected data from the device memory:

  • Notes
  • Schedule
  • Schedule and notes

Transfer data
Allows you to extract to the archive (export) the application data of your choice:

  • Notes
  • Schedule
  • Schedule and notes
or enter data into the application (import) created earlier using the export operation.

Share application
function Allows you to share a link to download the desktop or mobile version of the application. The link is available both in text form and as a QR code.

Contact developer
function Activated by pressing the application copyright.
Allows you to send an email with feedback to the application developer.

Widget

In the mobile version of the application for Android, the user can place on the main screen of the device a widget with a schedule for the group selected when adding the widget. Also, when adding a widget, the user can select the day to display the schedule: today or tomorrow, and the widget theme: light, dark or system. For users with Android version higher than 12, the "Use dynamic colors" option is available; when activated, the widget colors will take into account the color of the main screen wallpaper.
